WITH channel_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(f.feerate) as channel_avg_fee
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(channel_avg_fee) as bench_value
  FROM channel_avgs
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.orderbase,
    ca.channel_avg_fee,
    (ca.channel_avg_fee - b.bench_value) as exceedance
  FROM channel_avgs ca
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE ca.channel_avg_fee > b.bench_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(channel_avg_fee) as mean_of_above_avg_channels,
  AVG(exceedance) as mean_exceedance
FROM above_benchmark    -- Returns: (0.0010291190276711703, 1.8079756917792317e-05)
